verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair privacy question for a SaaS recruiting platform like Workable, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers API endpoints, webhooks, an MCP server and recruiting features, but documents no telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'full control over your data' API claim is about recruiting data access, not tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
